title: ExoProbe telescope network to find and recover an ET probe

tellings.quote: pick up the object and bring it down to the earth because that's what I would like to do to bring down an actual ET probe. So that's what exoprobe is about.

plain: The astronomer Beatriz Villarroel describes ExoProbe, a project of hers to build a network of telescopes in New Mexico to search for an alien probe near Earth. She tells Michels that the goal is to "pick up the object and bring it down to the earth," because what she would most like to do is "bring down an actual ET probe."
